item.title: Seafood and Clam Bar set to open new Brick location at former Rosalita’s, Eat at Joe’s site
item.description: Brick, NJ – Ocean County’s dining scene is about to get a major upgrade as Cuzin’s Seafood and Clam Bar prepares to open a new location at Brick Plaza, filling the longtime restaurant space once home to Rosalita’s Roadside Cantina and Tre Pizza Pasta and Beer Garden. The announcement comes just months after the popular Brick Plaza restaurants closed their doors following seven years in business.
